steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It... shattered?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The old man got this from some wizard.... Said it would keep me alive.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Didn't even make it through one fight, huh. I guess it was fake.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Just like I'm his fake daughter, maybe...? And now, like Reunion.... As well.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Mmm!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: *Cough* *cough*.... Blaze!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The cold's..... gone.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm fine! Amiya, hurry, go check on the white rabbit!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Nice win, Rhodes Island.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My brothers and sisters.... I let them die in vain.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: We accomplished nothing.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My life.... wasn't worth anything at all.

options: They followed you because of your ideas.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My death.... isn't worth anyone's time.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Go save who you can. Hurry.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Go.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Whether it's stopping the raincoats, going to kill Mephisto, or sheltering the Infected who have nowhere else to go....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Go. Go do something worthwhile.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, please tell her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What a.... naive rabbit.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Just like Talulah back then. Very similar.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: To be able to see someone like this before I die, someone so determined to realize their ideals....

options: What about the burden you bear?!
Didn't you promise to join Rhodes Island?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I guess that's been swirling around in your head, huh?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Villains are what villains are. I have no complaints about the ending I deserve.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I have hurt you. Reunion, and I, targeted innocent Lungmenites and single-handedly led the Ursus Infected into this nightmare. Such people have no business at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My brothers and sisters.... Those fools must have tried to keep me alive, huh?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I thought that even if I died here, those idiots would get a place where they could live in peace.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Wrong and wrong. They died. To protect me, a woman who didn't have much time left to begin with.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I'm not happy. We were used and abused. Our lives thrown away.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I'm not happy.... This last moment of life, this does not belong to me. They bought this with their blood!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: This little bit of life..... I must give it to someone trustworthy.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...Ah... Even if we survived, where is there to go?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: We had nowhere. The only thing we were ever knew was the snow.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Lungmen is not Ursus. We came, desperate to save our people, and the Infected, looking for a warm place, with food, and shelter....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: That's not Lungmen. From the beginning, it should not have been Lungmen. The people of Lungmen are also struggling to eke out a living.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: We should have gone back to Ursus.... Our homeland.....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Snow.... a peaceful river.... the pine forests gently swaying.... the turquoise moss....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: This world, it's beautiful....

options: So, you think Talulah is the one who orchestrated it all.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...If I'm right... The plot is ready to unfurl.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Even if old man Buldrokkas'tee could stall it for a while, Talulah would have a way to deal with him.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Lungmen can't do anything.... And all Ursus can do is watch.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But you're still here, and the Infected still have a chance. Even if only a small one...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ——go put an end to Talulah. Stop her madness and don't let Reunion swallow up any more Infected. Reunion doesn't need Talulah, any Talulah....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I could make a selfish request. Go save her. No. Go help her. Along with our countless fellow Infected....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The real one.... Walking on muddy earth.... Talulah....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Go... ahead.

options: I think your father really loves you.
Just like you remember your birth parents dying for you.
You remember clearly all that your father did for you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: How could I not know? It's just, he's going to outlive me.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: How much better it would have been if he had never adopted me. That way, he wouldn't have to feel all the pain I've brought him.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: He's suffered so much....

options: It is because he has suffered so much that he cherishes you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Hehehe....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...Doctor.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I can call you that, can't I?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Doctor of Rhodes Island, choices just might be meaningless, in this world.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Even so, even if the outcome makes no difference.... I do want to choose for myself. I made my choice.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: With my own hands.... To take the fruit of the seeds I have sown.
FrostNova's fingers grope at your face .

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Strange. Your face... is cold.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My body temperature.... Is not so low anymore?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I can finally touch someone... before I die.

options: FrostNova, Amiya and I want you to join Rhodes Island.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Do I really deserve that?

options: If you just die, here and now, you won't have a chance to right your wrongs.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...It would be rude not to give a response.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Tell Amiya, Dr. {@nickname}....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: In this world, a single person is worthless.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But she's absolutely not alone.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: From now on, I am at your side. Both of you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I......  would like to join Rhodes Island.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: No... thank you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Your eyes.... remind me of someone I used to know.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I met a boy who said his brother would rather go to the gallows than beg for his enemies' mercy....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: So he was going to walk across the snowy plains, he was going to walk all of Ursus.... And he didn't come with us.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I thought he was the most idealistic person I'd ever met.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But now, you and Amiya changed my mind... Maybe ideals can be a kind of faith.

options: Rhodes Island is all about fighting for shared beliefs.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The original Reunion.... was the same.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Just the same.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Your eyes, and that boy's, really do look the same.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Only, you're not as determined as he was. You're so much.... So much gentler.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Let me go. My brothers and sisters are waiting for me.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ......Father...... I've been such a fool.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Forgive me.
She slips down.
The corners of her mouth turn up, haughty as she was when she lived.
